name: Kikou Soushin Val-Kaizer
original_name: 機甲装神ヴァルカイザー
source:
In 21st century humanity started other planets colonization. Along with "bioloader" research to create a strengthened outer protective skin was underway. The lead researcher was afraid of military use of bioloader and set an explosion in the laboratory. His sister was found on the place of explosion miraculously saved.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/06/vn-of-month-july-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
进入21世纪后，人类开始殖民其他行星。与此同时，一种名为“生化装甲”的强化型外覆防护层也在研发之中。项目首席研究员担心生化装甲被用于军事，于是在实验室内引发爆炸。他的妹妹后来在爆炸现场被人发现，竟奇迹般地幸存了下来。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/06/vn-of-month-july-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
